title: GeoShift: a four-survey geochemical benchmark for cross-survey evaluation under detection-limit censoring (code)
description: Evaluation harness, fold assignments, metadata, per-task results and preregistration for GeoShift, a four-survey geochemical benchmark (GEMAS, NGSA, NASGL, Tellus) for cross-survey evaluation under detection-limit censoring. Source survey data are not redistributed; the harness fetches them from their official providers at build time.
